items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. It addresses 14 vulnerabilities, with 8 rated Critical and the highest CVSS score of 9.6.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, allows for unrestricted file upload with a CVSS score of 9.6.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical improper output encoding vulnerability, included in APSB26-73, carries a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-73, has a CVSS score of 8.6 and requires no authentication to exploit.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, rated 9.8 CVSS, which can lead to remote code execution. Mirasvit released a patched version on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This bulletin resolves 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including critical Stored XSS and Path Traversal issues. Adobe recommends applying the patch within 30 days.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.7, leading to arbitrary code execution, was addressed in APSB26-49.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical path traversal vulnerability, part of APSB26-49, has a CVSS score of 8.7 and could lead to arbitrary file system write.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Attacks have been observed on a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise store data. It fixes 19 CVEs, with 6 classified as critical.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.7, leading to privilege escalation and requiring admin access, was fixed in APSB26-05.
